input.summary: Implemented the complete Task Management API based on the provided architecture. This included creating an Event Bus, five distinct services (User, Project, Task, Comment, Notification), an API Router to handle HTTP requests, and a main entry point. Communication between services is handled asynchronously via the event bus. The system is written in TypeScript, uses only built-in Node.js modules, and was successfully type-checked with `tsc`. A demo script to exercise all features of the API was also included.
